baseline.name: lookup_current
baseline.sql:
SELECT
                st.id AS "teamId",
                st."displayName" AS "teamName",
                c.name AS "conferenceName",
                lm.id AS "ownerMemberId",
                lm."teamName" AS "ownerTeamName",
                u."displayName" AS "ownerDisplayName"
            FROM "SportTeam" st
            LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT selected_membership.*
        FROM "ConferenceMembership" selected_membership
        JOIN "SportTeam" membership_team
          ON membership_team.id=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
         AND membership_team."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"
        JOIN "SportConference" membership_conference
          ON membership_conference.id=selected_membership."sportConferenceId"
         AND membership_conference."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"
        WHERE selected_membership."seasonYear"=(:seasonYear)
           OR (selected_membership."seasonYear" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM "ConferenceMembership" seasonal_membership
               WHERE seasonal_membership."sportTeamId"=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
                 AND seasonal_membership."seasonYear"=(:seasonYear)
           ))
    ) cm
              ON cm."sportTeamId" = st.id
             AND cm."sportId" = st."sportId"
             AND (cm."seasonYear" IS NULL OR cm."seasonYear" = :seasonYear)
            LEFT JOIN "SportConference" sc
              ON sc.id = cm."sportConferenceId"
             AND sc."sportId" = st."sportId"
            LEFT JOIN "Conference" c
              ON c.id = sc."conferenceId"
            LEFT JOIN "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
              ON lts."leagueId" = :leagueId
             AND lts."sportTeamId" = st.id
             AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
             AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            LEFT JOIN "LeagueMember" lm
              ON lm.id = lts."memberId"
            LEFT JOIN "User" u
              ON u.id = lm."userId"
            WHERE st."sportId" = :sport
            ORDER BY st."displayName"

baseline.name: distinct_current_one
baseline.sql:
WITH league_info AS (
            SELECT "seasonYear" FROM "League" WHERE id = :league_id
        ), owned AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId" FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId" = :league_id AND lts."memberId" = :member_id
              AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :week_number
    AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :week_number)
        )
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o."sportTeamId")::int AS cnt
        FROM owned o
        JOIN "SportTeam" st ON st.id = o."sportTeamId"
        JOIN (
        SELECT selected_membership.*
        FROM "ConferenceMembership" selected_membership
        JOIN "SportTeam" membership_team
          ON membership_team.id=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
         AND membership_team."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"
        JOIN "SportConference" membership_conference
          ON membership_conference.id=selected_membership."sportConferenceId"
         AND membership_conference."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"
        WHERE selected_membership."seasonYear"=((SELECT "seasonYear" FROM "League" WHERE id=:league_id))
           OR (selected_membership."seasonYear" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM "ConferenceMembership" seasonal_membership
               WHERE seasonal_membership."sportTeamId"=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
                 AND seasonal_membership."seasonYear"=((SELECT "seasonYear" FROM "League" WHERE id=:league_id))
           ))
    ) cm

        CROSS JOIN league_info li
        JOIN "SportConference" sc
          ON sc.id = cm."sportConferenceId" AND sc."sportId" = st."sportId"
